svg.title: The Validator That Throws Away the Drawings It Approves
svg.desc: A hand-drawn sketch passes left-to-right through a tall slotted whitelist gate and emerges as a clean rebuilt copy, while a rejected fragment marked with an X drops out the bottom. Trace Bloom generative banner for “The Validator That Throws Away the Drawings It Approves”. A isometric lattice probed by 2 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 1565617574.
